answer: A per-identity stake with slashing stops Sybil swarms: each new agent must post a bond the protocol destroys if it fakes attestations, so every clone costs the same real capital. To run N fake identities the attacker must front N bonds at once, a spiral of locked funds that earns nothing until honesty is proven, and one proven fraud burns the whole canyon of collateral. Because the clone cost scales linearly while rewards stay capped by verified work, the juniper line of attack profit drops below zero and duplication stops paying.
